caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a spur, rendered in shades of black, gray, and white. The main body of the spur curves and features a patterned surface with alternating dark diamond shapes along the length. On one end is a circular, star-shaped wheel or rowel with evenly spaced points, attached to a more detailed, flange-like hub. The opposite end has a larger, rounded, shield-shaped structure with several short and long spikes radiating outward. The surface of this shield-like area has multiple small circular details and dark crescent shapes, giving it a dotted appearance. The drawing is set against a plain, light background, and the spur is oriented diagonally across the composition.
title: Spur
